cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Will you put my name under 'cake design' before you frame our club's prize certificate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Next year's members won't. There's a blank ready for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List us all, with what each did. I'll fetch everyone's names before you seal the frame.
